spans.s: (I)--a daughter of Kardama married to An- girasa. Mother of four daughters--सिनीवाली, कुहू, राका and अनुमती and sons Utathya and बृहस्पति. भा. III. २४. २२;
(II)--a daughter of दक्ष and wife of Dharma; mother of शुभ and काम. भा.
(III)--a wife of श्राद्धदेव and mother of ten sons; observed पयोव्रत and wanted the birth of a daughter. इला was born. भा.
--a son of शत्रुघ्न, the son of अनाधृष्ठि. M. ४६. २४.
(IV)--one of the wives of Vasudeva and mother of गवेषवान्. M. ४६. २०.
(I)--a son of शान्तिदेव and Vasudeva. भा. IX. २४. ५०.
--a sage; nine sons of ऋषभ became this. भा.
--a son of अश्विनी and अक्रूर. M. ४५. ३३. [page३-475+ २४]

(III)--(Manu: a son of Vivasvata and सम्ज्ञा: Seventh Manu (s.v.) Manu Vaivasvata. Satyavrata in previous birth. भा.
(IV)--Yama; the former birth of गवेषुण; a destroyer of Indra; father of Ekalavya. वा. ९६. १८२.
--one of Vasudeva's wives: mother of गनेष. Br. III. ७१. १८४.
--a son of युवनाश्व and the founder of the city of श्रावस्ति; the father of ब्रह्मदश्व. Br. III. ६३. २७; M. १२. ३०; वा. ८८. २६-7.
